biggest_catch: Both sides get their $50 bill credit only when the referred customer's third bill arrives; if the friend cancels before then, no one earns anything.
catches: Bill credits apply when the referred customer reaches their third bill; both referrer and referee credits are applied at the same time.
Referral credits have no cash value and can only be applied to the account balance.
Referred customer must be new, enroll with the referral ID/link, and live in BKV Energy's serviceable area.
No self-referral with multiple or fake accounts; no referring the same person more than once; no signing someone up without permission.
Program can be changed at any time.
BKV Energy serves deregulated Texas service territories; plan rates, term, and early-termination fees still apply.
Frame as savings on planned electricity spending, never income.
